posts.name: UXM266
posts.cooked:
So, I was trying for the unlock for Idealist. I thought just keeping Monster of Id in play for as long as possible. I went to Temple of Zhu Long, against Ambuscade.

 

i brought XPW AA, Tempest,  Doctor Medico, and of Idealist. 

I had ID, Superego, and the Tiara our. No other concepts.

She never died. There was much healing. Even with 12 cards and more she also gained enough to get back to full.

Played this game twice

defeated Ambuscade with a bored now, and once with a fragment. 

 

No unlock either way
